CoveredScenarios.Description: Returns a single agent name when one agent is provided to the loader
Returns multiple agent names when multiple agents are provided to the loader
Returns an empty list when no agents are provided to the loader
Returns an ImmutableList type and rejects mutation attempts
Returns consistent results on repeated/successive calls to listAgents
Returns only string agent names matching the agents that were loaded
Never returns null, even when no agents are loaded
Preserves distinct agent names and contains all expected names
Integration test with a real LlmAgent instance verifying listAgents contains the agent name

UncoveredScenarios.Description: Behavior when duplicate agent names are provided (e.g., two agents with the same name) - verifies whether duplicates are deduplicated or overwritten in the underlying map
Ordering of agent names in the returned list matches the insertion/construction order
Behavior with agents having empty string names
Behavior with agents having null names - verifies whether NullPointerException or other error is thrown during construction or listing
Behavior with a large number of agents (e.g., hundreds or thousands) to verify scalability and correctness
Thread safety - calling listAgents concurrently from multiple threads returns consistent and correct results
Behavior with agents having special characters, unicode, or whitespace-only names
Verifying that the returned list is a new snapshot and not affected by any subsequent modifications to the loader's internal state (if applicable)
Behavior when agents with very long names are provided

CoveredScenarios.Description: Load agent with a valid name that exists in the loader returns the correct agent instance
Load agent with null name throws IllegalArgumentException with appropriate message
Load agent with empty string name throws IllegalArgumentException with appropriate message
Load agent with whitespace-only name throws IllegalArgumentException with appropriate message
Load agent with a non-existent name throws NoSuchElementException with message containing the requested name
Load agent from a loader containing multiple agents returns the correct matching agent
Load agent with name containing leading and trailing spaces does not trim and throws NoSuchElementException (exact match behavior)
Load agent with tab character only name throws IllegalArgumentException (treated as blank/whitespace)
Load agent from a loader initialized with a single agent returns that agent successfully
Load agent with different letter casing than registered name throws NoSuchElementException (case-sensitive lookup)
Load agent with newline character only name throws IllegalArgumentException (treated as blank/whitespace)
NoSuchElementException message exactly matches the format 'Agent not found: <requestedName>'
Load agent using LlmAgent builder-created agent verifies integration with real agent objects

UncoveredScenarios.Description: Load agent with a name that contains special characters (e.g., '@', '#', '!') that exists in the loader returns the agent successfully
Load agent with a very long string name that does not exist throws NoSuchElementException
Load agent called multiple times with the same valid name returns the same agent instance each time (idempotency)
Load agent with a name containing mixed whitespace and valid characters (e.g., 'my agent') that does not match any registered agent throws NoSuchElementException
Load agent from a loader initialized with agents having duplicate names verifies which agent is returned (last wins or first wins based on map behavior)
Load agent with a name that is a substring of an existing agent's name throws NoSuchElementException (no partial matching)
Load agent with Unicode characters in the name that matches a registered agent returns the correct agent
Load the first agent and then the last agent from a loader with many agents to verify all positions are accessible
Load agent from a loader initialized with zero agents (empty varargs) throws NoSuchElementException for any name
Load agent with a name containing only carriage return character ('\r') throws IllegalArgumentException
